en: Fixed sessions failing turn after turn with "Invalid effort level" when an organization's admin caps a model's effort: Claude Code now lowers the effort, retries, and says which level it uses
zh: 修复当组织管理员限制某模型的 effort 时，session 因 "Invalid effort level" 一轮接一轮失败的问题：Claude Code 现在会降低 effort、重试，并说明使用的级别
